method: Week-by-week prior-game scoring form reconstructed from historical graded FBS matchups only. Train Weeks 1-5, held-out Weeks 6-8. Held-out scores were not used to select coefficients, but the exploratory feature search creates multiple-comparison uncertainty. Home calibration is +6 points beyond existing site HFA. Live mode's data source includes additional prior games, so results are an approximation of live operation.

variants.name: Experimental Form + Home
variants.formula: original projected home margin + (neutral ? 0 : 6) + 0.4 * (home last3-margin minus season margin - away last3-margin plus season margin), clipped recent-form component to +/-8 points

candidateFactors: recent score margin vs prior season average
unavailableFactors: true time of possession by possession
warning: Backtested model uses currently stored BASE power ratings which may have been updated in-season; historical odds are not verified as closing. Results are not proof of future edge. Do not market as profitable.
